notes:
Account snapshot: mid-sized enterprise search vendor; builds verticalized RAG for finance and legal customers. Heavy emphasis on embedding quality + reranker performance. Currently running cross-encoder reranker on top of a dense-vector candidate set (bi-encoder) — expensive at scale. Looking to migrate to lighter reranker + evaluation-driven rollout to cut cost and improve latency without degrading relevance.

Key constraints & asks (verbatim/near):
- "P95 < 150ms for top-K pipeline end-to-end (embedding lookup + reranker) for web-tier queries"
- indexing scale ~ 400M active passages (sharded across 12 clusters)
- target cost-per-query <= $0.002 (avg across steady-state traffic)
- must pass our eval harness (precision@10, MRR, A/B win-rate) before any traffic migration
- security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, US-EAST data residency

Conversation flavour: quick bullets, lots of shorthand. On last call AE/SE demo: "we need to see that we don't lose 1-2% MRR on our top flows". Legal: slower but not blocking for POC; infosec wants full threat model for private deployment.

summary_requirements: Migration project: replace existing heavy cross-encoder reranker with two-stage approach (bi-encoder candidates + lightweight reranker), run A/B + canary rollouts controlled by eval suites. Must match or exceed current relevance metrics (precision@10, MRR) and meet latency/cost SLOs. Need SDK/instrumentation to run per-query eval tags and per-route dashboards. SSO + audit/KMS mandatory for production. Prefer VPC private control plane; open to Redwood Dedicated if price/perf shown.
migration_plan:
Phase 0: baseline capture (3 weeks) — ingest gold queries, label sets, synthetic traffic; collect current P95 and cost metrics. Phase 1: offline evals (2 weeks) — run Redwood Optimize recommendations; compare embeddings variants (fp16, quantized) and reranker architectures against gold set. Phase 2: canary (5% traffic, 2 weeks) w/ real-time eval gating. Phase 3: A/B extended (30%/70%, 4 weeks) with rollback automation and automatic fallback to cross-encoder if eval delta > threshold. Requirements for canary: per-route telemetry, per-token cost breakdown, immediate rollback hook.

POC deliverables: eval harness, cost estimate for full index, latency heatmap, canary runbook.
eval_strategy: Evals-driven migration. Customer demands reproducible evals: fixed gold query set (~20k queries), labeled relevance at top-10 for critical flows, offline MRR + precision@k, and online A/B win-rate with Bayesian stopping rules. Want Redwood Optimize to surface embedding/rerank configs and quantization tradeoffs; need comparison artifacts (CSV) and sample prompts. If regression > 1% MRR on finance/legal flows, rollback automatically. Also request sample evaluation notebook and lightweight CI check to run on new model bundles.
sales_play_notes:

Secondary champion: Platform Eng (Naveen Rao) wants VPC/KMS and terraform modules. Value props to hit: measurable cost reduction, preserved or improved relevance, predictable rollout tooling.

Objections: internal teams worry about "silent quality regressions" during embedding changes; asked for runbook for canary rollback and eval dashboards. Finance wants clear TCO for 400M index migration (ingest + compute + storage).
closing_signals: allocated budget in Q2 contingent on POC success; Leah verbally committed to champion within execs if POC shows <=0.5% regression and 30% cost savings
